question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989 THEN '20s'
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1970 AND 1979 THEN '30s'
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1960 AND 1969 THEN '40s'
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'Others'
  END AS age_category,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM mst_users
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY age_category
